title: 保育士を目指していたエッチなカラダの大学生【圧倒的4K映像でヌク！】
synopsis: In February 2024, STZY-011 produced by SOD Create is a JAV production starring Satsukinao. Content centres on Big Tits, POV and Documentary material, spanning a 72-minute programme. Satsukinao leads the cast of STZY-011, offering viewers the kind of performance her audience has come to expect. The title is available to stream and download from its official FANZA source.
